title: fhEVM test engine environment profile (v1)
description: Describes one target environment: whether it requires confirmation, the typed sections owned by engine modules (chain, relayer, contracts) and the generic settings scenarios can read. Every field is enforced at runtime; unknown fields are rejected. A value is exactly one of {value}, {env} or {env, default}; secrets (secret: true) must come from env, and their only allowed default is the empty string (meaning "not set").

name.description: Profile name. Must match the file name (<name>.yaml). 'none' is reserved for the built-in profile.

requiresConfirmation.description: When true, 'run' requires --confirm <name>, and scenarios must list this profile explicitly in spec.targets.

envFiles.description: Env files (KEY=VALUE) read in memory, relative to this profile file. The process environment takes precedence.

settings.description: Generic settings read by scenarios through this.engine.profile.setting(key).

env.description: Environment variable name (process environment, then env files).

default.description: Fallback when the variable is not set (only with env; for secrets, only the empty string).

secret.description: Sensitive value: redacted from every output.

relayerSection.description: Typed section owned by the FHE module (this.engine.fhe): the relayer and the gateway chain. Every field is a value source, checked after resolution.

url.description: Relayer URL (http or https), with or without the API version suffix (/v1, /v2).

apiKey.description: Relayer API key, sent on every relayer call. Must declare secret: true; an empty value means no authentication.

decryption.description: Address of the Decryption contract on the gateway chain.

inputVerification.description: Address of the InputVerification contract on the gateway chain.

contractsSection.description: Protocol contracts deployed on the host chain, read by the FHE module and by test-engine compile (acl, executor, kmsVerifier feed the e2e coprocessor config). Every field is a value source holding an address, checked after resolution.

executor.description: The FHEVMExecutor (CoprocessorAddress of the Solidity coprocessor config).

chainSection.description: Typed section owned by the Chain module (this.engine.chain). rpcUrl, chainId and mnemonic are value sources, checked after resolution; the mnemonic must be secret.

chainId.description: Expected chain ID (positive integer); checked against eth_chainId before the first transaction.

mnemonic.description: BIP-39 mnemonic of the wallets. Must declare secret: true.

hdPath.description: HD derivation path prefix; the account index is appended. Same default as the e2e Hardhat config.

wallets.description: Wallet roles and their account index. Same default roles and indices as the e2e suite.

gas.description: Gas limit rule for transactions sent without an explicit gasLimit: estimate * (100 + bufferPercent) / 100, capped at limitCap. Same defaults as the e2e suite.
